decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed erection of a two-storey side and single storey rear extension because of their position, design and appearance, would not harm the appearance of the locality or neighbours' living conditions. The development therefore complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and is compliant with the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. NKJ/04/100A shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the information given in the submitted drawings, the external walls of the extension shall be finished in red/brown sandfaced brickwork or such other materials as shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
